about: ValueInput (types/0x0011-value-input.md; zadania/devices/DEVICE-02.md): profile dial, ep4 StepSize 20 ‰, Wrap 0, ReportMinGap 1000 ms. A turn is `turn`: endpoint → detents, collected by the board and handed in once per loop — several at once are ONE Changed with the summed delta (§5.3, N11). Every change by a person is a Changed at once and a report under ReportMinGap; a step past a limit reaches it, one at the limit does nothing and says nothing (§5.2); a write from the hub changes Value without Changed, is reported as every write and stored at once (§5.5, N13); Value and ChangeCount are stored 5 s after the last turn (§5.6); with Wrap only a step FROM a limit wraps, and delta is arithmetic (S2); narrowing the range clips Value, reported, without Changed; a Value outside the range and Min > Max are INVALID_VALUE (S1).
